cohort: Women aged ≥ 18 years residing in Kirehe District Hospital (KDH) catchment area who delivered by c-section at KDH between April 1 and September 30, 2017
finding: Previous cesarean section was the primary indication for cesarean delivery, and most of these cases were emergent or urgent on presentation.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was the primary indication for cesarean delivery, with most cases presenting as urgent or emergent.
